escena: SCENE (finance desk, Santiago, evening): the frame looks THROUGH the tool of the trade — a heavy glass reading loupe held over a printed budget sheet, its lens filling much of the picture. Through the glass, one cost line is crisp and magnified; immediately beside it, the results column is visibly empty, with no figure against that cost. A hard low desk lamp throws a long shadow of the folder across the sheet. At most a blurred cuff of a jacket sleeve enters at the edge. A dark blue folder lies under the sheet, and a small orange shape rests on its cover, half in shadow. 100mm macro lens at f/4, focus on the magnified line inside the glass. Everything except that orange shape is completely unbranded. No readable text or numbers anywhere: the figures are small, angled and out of focus outside the loupe, and inside it they read as marks, not as amounts.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the walnut desk against the lens

texto.muro: the bare desktop continuing above in even shadow, its grain visible

instrumento: a heavy glass reading loupe held over the printed budget sheet
